The camera moves and pans, causing the position of the tape and doors to shift within the frame; the view widens and shifts left to reveal the downward curve of the track and the floor/baseboard area on the left.
The ball remains on the track throughout the clip.
outside_clip_unknowns: The initial state of the ball before it started rolling (it is already in motion/positioned on the slope at the start of the crop).
Whether the ball continues rolling off the end of the track or stops after the clip ends.
uncertain_details: The exact speed of the ball is difficult to determine precisely due to the simultaneous camera movement.
The specific mechanism holding the track to the doors is obscured by the tape and angle.
